blocking: No inherited prefixes such as eds-* or system-*.
No hex colors outside token declarations.
No raw px values outside token declarations.
Foundation and primitive inventory must match the machine-readable spec.
Foundation and primitive detail section functions must exist in the rendered app.
Gold components must expose component tokens.
maturityWarnings: Components need states, accessibility, responsive behavior, API, and tests.
Patterns need entry conditions, decision trees, failure modes, metrics, and components used.
Templates need realistic data, permissions, loading, empty, error, offline, recovery, and telemetry states.
qualityGates.definitionOfDone: An artifact is done only at maturity level 3 or 4.
